snippet.title: New Ways to Play | Club Penguin Zero Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming to Club Penguin Zero: Waddle Games!

Alongside the classic (and new) Club Penguin Minigames comes a new way to play: Waddle Games!

These are games that you can play and participate in while waddling around and meeting new friends! 

Here you can see these two penguins seem to be queueing up for a new game called Disco Domination...

Club Penguin Zero releases October 24th! Stay tuned for more news and information, alongside learning how to unlock an EXCLUSIVE Waddle Game for Beta Players!

Check it out! - https://www.cpzero.net/
Twitter -   https://twitter.com/CPZeroOfficial
Discord -   https://discord.gg/N8sEcSdzwc
